verdict.rationale: Coinbase x402 documents an official 'Bazaar MCP server' that lets MCP-compatible agents discover payable services via tool calls, and states discovery reaches agents through this MCP server alongside CDP APIs and AgentCore. However, the evidence pack gives only passing mentions of the MCP server (no setup docs, endpoint details, or hands-on confirmation of actually connecting to it), and payment execution itself still runs over HTTP 402 rather than through the MCP server. Missing for 10: dedicated MCP server documentation/setup guide, independent/hands-on confirmation of connecting an agent via this MCP server, and clarity on what functionality (discovery vs. payment) is exposed through it.
